Penetration is a mechanic that reduces the effect of Resistance during Combat Calculations. The amount of Penetration is subtracted from the corresponding Resistance which can go below 0. Damage Over Time effects can also benefit from Penetration.

Damage after penetration can be calculated as follows:

((1 - min(Resistance - Resistance shred, 75)) + Resistance Penetration) * Damage Taken

Enemies have +1% Penetration to all elements per level. (up to 75% ?)
